package TDHud
import TDConfig
import TDState
import TDWaves
import ClosureTimers
import TDPetState
import TDEnemyMechanicData
import TDDamageHud
import TDDamageRuntime
import TDWaveFlowState
import GameTimer

multiboard tdStatusBoard = null
string array tdPetHudSummaries

public function tdHudLaneStatus(boolean active, boolean finished, boolean defeated, int wave, int waveCount) returns string
	if not active
		return "未开启"
	if finished
		return "已完成"
	if defeated
		return "已失守"
	if wave == 0
		return "待命"
	return "第 " + wave.toString() + "/" + waveCount.toString() + " 波"

public function tdHudPhaseText(boolean gameOver, boolean anyFinished, int wave, boolean queued, int queuedWave, int waveCount) returns string
	if gameOver
		if anyFinished
			return "胜利 · 防守完成"
		return "失败 · 已停止刷怪，请重新开局"
	if wave == 0
		return "开局准备 · 尚未刷怪"
	if queued
		return "等待第 " + queuedWave.toString() + "/" + waveCount.toString() + " 波"
	return "第 " + wave.toString() + "/" + waveCount.toString() + " 波进行中"

public function tdHudChapter(int wave) returns string
	if wave <= 8
		return "第一章"
	if wave <= 16
		return "第二章"
	if wave <= 24
		return "第三章"
	return "终章"

public function tdHudThreatText(int wave) returns string
	if wave < 1 or wave > tdWaveCount()
		return "无后续波次"
	return "下波 " + wave.toString() + " · 普通 " + tdWaveNormalEnemyCount(wave).toString() + " 精英 " + tdWaveEliteEnemyCount(wave).toString() + " 近卫 " + tdWaveBossGuardEnemyCount(wave).toString() + " Boss " + tdWaveBossEnemyCount(wave).toString()

function tdHudSetBossIcon(int row, int wave)
	let icon = tdIsGameOver() ? "" : tdBossIconPath(wave)
	tdStatusBoard.setItemIcon(row, 1, icon)
	let cell = tdStatusBoard.getItem(row, 1)
	cell.setStyle(false, icon != "")
	cell.release()

public function tdHudBossMechanicText(int wave) returns string
	if tdFlowIsPreparing()
		return "Boss待入场：等待旧波清场与精灵窗口"
	if tdFlowHeldTransitionToken() != 0
		return "阶段休整 · 等待挑战结束"
	if tdFlowIsBossActive()
		var remaining = 0
		for lane = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
			remaining = IMaxBJ(remaining, tdFlowBossSecondsRemaining(lane, getElapsedGameTime()))
		return tdEnemyMechanicHint(wave) + " · 剩余" + remaining + "s"
	return tdEnemyMechanicHint(wave)

public function tdRefreshStatusBoard()
	if compiletime or tdStatusBoard == null
		return
	var anyFinished = false
	var row = 1
	for playerId = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
		if tdIsLaneActive(playerId)
			anyFinished = anyFinished or tdIsLaneFinished(playerId)
			tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(row, 0, "玩家" + (playerId + 1).toString())
			tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(row, 1, tdGetLives(playerId))
			tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(row, 2, tdHudLaneStatus(true, tdIsLaneFinished(playerId), tdIsLaneDefeated(playerId), tdGetGlobalWave(), tdWaveCount()))
			row += 1
	let phase = tdHudPhaseText(tdIsGameOver(), anyFinished, tdGetGlobalWave(), tdIsNextWaveQueued(), tdGetQueuedWave(), tdWaveCount())
	tdStatusBoard.setTitle(tdHudChapter(tdGetGlobalWave()) + " · " + phase)
	let nextWave = tdIsNextWaveQueued() ? tdGetQueuedWave() : tdGetGlobalWave() + 1
	tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(row, 0, "预告")
	tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(row, 1, "")
	tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(row, 2, tdIsGameOver() ? "本局结束" : tdHudThreatText(nextWave))
	row += 1
	// A separate short row keeps mechanic hints out of the already full threat line.
	tdHudSetBossIcon(row, tdFlowIsPreparing() ? 0 : tdGetGlobalWave())
	tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(row, 0, "本波")
	tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(row, 1, "")
	tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(row, 2, tdIsGameOver() ? "机制已结束" : tdHudBossMechanicText(tdGetGlobalWave()))
	row += 1
	tdHudSetBossIcon(row, nextWave)
	tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(row, 0, "下波")
	tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(row, 1, "")
	tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(row, 2, tdIsGameOver() or nextWave > tdWaveCount() ? "无后续机制" : tdEnemyMechanicHint(nextWave))
	row += 1
	// Compute every lane on all clients before selecting only display text locally.
	for playerId = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
		tdPetHudSummaries[playerId] = "球" + tdPetBallsForLane(playerId) + " · 收藏" + tdPetCollectionCount(playerId) + "/20 · 洗" + tdPetRerollStones[playerId] + " · 开" + tdPetSlotStones[playerId]
	let lane = GetPlayerId(GetLocalPlayer())
	tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(row, 0, "宝宝")
	tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(row, 1, "")
	if tdIsLanePlayer(lane)
		tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(row, 2, tdPetHudSummaries[lane])
	else
		tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(row, 2, "旁观")

	row += 1
	tdDamageRefreshCatalog()
	tdDamageRefreshHud(tdStatusBoard, row)

public function tdSetupHud()
	if compiletime or tdStatusBoard != null
		return
	tdStatusBoard = CreateMultiboard()
	tdStatusBoard.setColumnCount(TD_DAMAGE_HUD_COLUMNS)
	tdStatusBoard.setRowCount(tdCountActiveLanes() + 5 + TD_DAMAGE_HUD_ROWS)
	tdStatusBoard.setItemsStyle(true, false)
	// Keep upper status text widths; a narrow fourth cell is empty above rankings.
	let firstDamageRow = tdCountActiveLanes() + 5
	for row = 0 to firstDamageRow - 1
		tdStatusBoard.setItemWidth(row, 0, 0.055)
		tdStatusBoard.setItemWidth(row, 1, 0.065)
		tdStatusBoard.setItemWidth(row, 2, 0.25)
		tdStatusBoard.setItemWidth(row, 3, 0.005)
	for row = firstDamageRow to firstDamageRow + TD_DAMAGE_HUD_ROWS - 1
		tdStatusBoard.setItemWidth(row, 0, 0.07)
		tdStatusBoard.setItemWidth(row, 1, 0.065)
		tdStatusBoard.setItemWidth(row, 2, 0.18)
		tdStatusBoard.setItemWidth(row, 3, 0.06)
	for row = firstDamageRow to firstDamageRow + 4
		tdStatusBoard.setItemWidth(row, 0, 0.13)
		tdStatusBoard.setItemWidth(row, 1, 0.235)
		tdStatusBoard.setItemWidth(row, 2, 0.005)
		tdStatusBoard.setItemWidth(row, 3, 0.005)
	tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(0, 0, "路线")
	tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(0, 1, "生命")
	tdStatusBoard.setItemValue(0, 2, "进度 / 下波威胁")
	tdRefreshStatusBoard()
	tdStatusBoard.show()
	tdStatusBoard.maximize()
	doPeriodically(1.0) cb ->
		tdRefreshStatusBoard()
		if tdIsGameOver()
			destroy cb

package TDInit
import TDState
import TDGame
import TDSpawn
import TDTowers
import TDItems
import TDInventory
import TDGroundItemRuntime
import TDConfig
import ClosureTimers
import TDHud
import TDPets
import TDEnemyMechanicRuntime
import TDDamageRuntime
import RegisterEvents

trigger tdChatCommandTrigger = CreateTrigger()
boolean tdGameplayStartupCompleted = false
// This listener lives for the process, independently of match resets.
boolean tdLanePlayerLeaveWatcherReady = false

public function tdMapBootstrapDelay() returns real
	return 0.10

public function tdMapBootstrapRetryInterval() returns real
	return 0.25

public function tdMapBootstrapMaxRetries() returns int
	return 8

public function tdShouldRevealWholeMap() returns boolean
	return true

public function tdDefaultCameraTargetDistance() returns real
	return 3200.0

public function tdDefaultCameraAngleOfAttack() returns real
	return 315.0

public function tdCameraWheelLiftStepCount() returns int
	return 3

public function tdCameraWheelLiftDistancePerStep() returns real
	return 400.0

public function tdStartingCameraReapplyDelay() returns real
	return 0.10

public function tdCameraDistanceClampInterval() returns real
	return 0.15

public function tdShouldFocusStartingCameraOnFarmer() returns boolean
	return true

public function tdShouldSelectStartingFarmer() returns boolean
	return false

public function tdCameraTargetDistanceForWheelLift(int extraSteps) returns real
	var clampedSteps = extraSteps
	if clampedSteps < 0
		clampedSteps = 0
	if clampedSteps > tdCameraWheelLiftStepCount()
		clampedSteps = tdCameraWheelLiftStepCount()
	return tdDefaultCameraTargetDistance() + clampedSteps * tdCameraWheelLiftDistancePerStep()

public function tdCameraTargetDistanceMin() returns real
	return tdCameraTargetDistanceForWheelLift(0)

public function tdCameraTargetDistanceMax() returns real
	return tdCameraTargetDistanceForWheelLift(tdCameraWheelLiftStepCount())

public function tdClampCameraTargetDistance(real distance) returns real
	if distance < tdCameraTargetDistanceMin()
		return tdCameraTargetDistanceMin()
	if distance > tdCameraTargetDistanceMax()
		return tdCameraTargetDistanceMax()
	return distance

public function tdStartupGuideMessage() returns string
	return "守住起点到终点的路线，在高台建塔。B 建造 / U 范围升级 / C 背包合成 / G 工资；Q 捕获 / W 收藏 / E 上阵。发起建造后建筑自行施工。滚轮调整镜头；精灵与装备都可强化塔。|n每漏过1名敌人扣除生命：普通1、精英和近卫队长2、首领3。首领关每路1名，入场后90秒限时。"
function tdInactiveLaneNoticePlayerActiveForTest(int playerId, boolean lane0Active, boolean lane1Active, boolean lane2Active, boolean lane3Active) returns boolean
	if playerId == 0
		return lane0Active
	if playerId == 1
		return lane1Active
	if playerId == 2
		return lane2Active
	return lane3Active

public function tdInactiveLaneNoticeForTest(boolean lane0Active, boolean lane1Active, boolean lane2Active, boolean lane3Active) returns string
	var inactiveCount = 0
	var message = "未开启玩家："
	for playerId = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
		if not tdInactiveLaneNoticePlayerActiveForTest(playerId, lane0Active, lane1Active, lane2Active, lane3Active)
			if inactiveCount > 0
				message += "、"
			message += (playerId + 1).toString()
			inactiveCount += 1
	if inactiveCount == 0
		return ""
	return message + "。本局只启动已进入游戏的路线。"

function tdInactiveLaneNoticeMessage() returns string
	return tdInactiveLaneNoticeForTest(tdIsLaneActive(0), tdIsLaneActive(1), tdIsLaneActive(2), tdIsLaneActive(3))

function tdAddMoneyCommandPrefix() returns string
	return "-addMoney "

function tdAddMoneyCommandUsage() returns string
	return "用法: -addMoney 1000"

function tdStartsWith(string value, string prefix) returns boolean
	let prefixLength = StringLength(prefix)
	return StringLength(value) >= prefixLength and SubString(value, 0, prefixLength) == prefix

function tdParseAddMoneyAmount(string message) returns int
	let prefix = tdAddMoneyCommandPrefix()
	if not tdStartsWith(message, prefix)
		return 0
	let amount = S2I(SubString(message, StringLength(prefix), StringLength(message)))
	if amount <= 0
		return 0
	return amount

public function tdTryHandleAddMoneyCommand(int playerId, string message) returns boolean
	if not tdIsLanePlayer(playerId)
		return false
	let amount = tdParseAddMoneyAmount(message)
	if amount <= 0
		return false
	tdGainGold(playerId, amount)
	return true

function tdRevealWholeMap()
	if tdShouldRevealWholeMap()
		FogEnableOff()
		FogMaskEnableOff()

function tdShouldEnableLaneForPlayer(int playerId) returns boolean
	return GetPlayerController(Player(playerId)) == MAP_CONTROL_USER and GetPlayerSlotState(Player(playerId)) == PLAYER_SLOT_STATE_PLAYING

function tdDetectActiveLanes()
	for playerId = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
		tdSetLaneActive(playerId, tdShouldEnableLaneForPlayer(playerId))

public function tdStartupFallbackPlayerId() returns int
	return 0

public function tdEnsureStartupFallbackLane()
	if tdCountActiveLanes() == 0
		// 单人测试或异常槽位状态下仍启动 P1，保证地图能被本地快速验证。
		tdSetLaneActive(tdStartupFallbackPlayerId(), true)

function tdApplyStartingCamera()
	for playerId = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
		if tdIsLaneActive(playerId)
			Player(playerId).setCameraField(CAMERA_FIELD_TARGET_DISTANCE, tdCameraTargetDistanceForWheelLift(0), 0.0)
			Player(playerId).setCameraField(CAMERA_FIELD_ANGLE_OF_ATTACK, tdDefaultCameraAngleOfAttack(), 0.0)

function tdFocusStartingCameraOnFarmers()
	if not tdShouldFocusStartingCameraOnFarmer()
		return
	for playerId = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
		if tdIsLaneActive(playerId) and localPlayer == Player(playerId)
			let farmer = tdGetFarmer(playerId)
			if farmer != null
				let pos = farmer.getPos()
				SetCameraPosition(pos.x, pos.y)
				if tdShouldSelectStartingFarmer()
					ClearSelection()
					SelectUnit(farmer, true)

function tdLiftStartingCameraAgain()
	doAfter(tdStartingCameraReapplyDelay()) ->
		tdApplyStartingCamera()
		tdFocusStartingCameraOnFarmers()

function tdClampLocalCameraDistance()
	for playerId = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
		if tdIsLaneActive(playerId) and localPlayer == Player(playerId)
			let currentDistance = GetCameraField(CAMERA_FIELD_TARGET_DISTANCE)
			let clampedDistance = tdClampCameraTargetDistance(currentDistance)
			if clampedDistance != currentDistance
				SetCameraField(CAMERA_FIELD_TARGET_DISTANCE, clampedDistance, 0.20)

function tdStartCameraDistanceClamp()
	doPeriodically(tdCameraDistanceClampInterval()) cb ->
		if tdIsGameOver()
			destroy cb
		else
			tdClampLocalCameraDistance()

function tdHandleChatCommand()
	let triggeringPlayer = GetTriggerPlayer()
	let playerId = GetPlayerId(triggeringPlayer)
	let message = GetEventPlayerChatString()
	if not tdIsLaneActive(playerId)
		return
	let amount = tdParseAddMoneyAmount(message)
	if amount <= 0
		DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(triggeringPlayer, 0, 0, 4.0, tdAddMoneyCommandUsage())
		return
	tdTryHandleAddMoneyCommand(playerId, message)
	tdRefreshHud()
	DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(triggeringPlayer, 0, 0, 4.0, "已增加 " + amount.toString() + " 金币。当前金币：" + tdGetGold(playerId).toString())

function tdSetupChatCommands()
	for playerId = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
		TriggerRegisterPlayerChatEvent(tdChatCommandTrigger, Player(playerId), "-addMoney", false)
	TriggerAddAction(tdChatCommandTrigger, function tdHandleChatCommand)

function tdHandleLanePlayerLeaveEvent() returns boolean
	tdHandleLanePlayerLeft(GetPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer()))
	return false

public function tdSetupLanePlayerLeaveWatcher() returns boolean
	if tdLanePlayerLeaveWatcherReady
		return false
	tdLanePlayerLeaveWatcherReady = true
	if not compiletime
		registerPlayerEvent(EVENT_PLAYER_LEAVE, function tdHandleLanePlayerLeaveEvent)
	return true

function tdRunGameplayStartup()
	if tdGameplayStartupCompleted
		return
	tdGameplayStartupCompleted = true
	let enemyPlayer = Player(TD_ENEMY_PLAYER_ID)
	RemoveAllGuardPositions(enemyPlayer)
	for playerId = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
		SetPlayerAlliance(enemyPlayer, Player(playerId), ALLIANCE_PASSIVE, false)
		SetPlayerAlliance(Player(playerId), enemyPlayer, ALLIANCE_PASSIVE, false)
	// 这里以后只装配运行时系统；地形/pathing 之类的可视布局仍由地图文件维护。
	tdCreatePads()
	for playerId = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
		if tdIsLaneActive(playerId)
			tdPetInitializeFarmer(playerId, tdGetFarmer(playerId))
	tdSetupPets()
	tdSetupLanePlayerLeaveWatcher()
	tdSetupDamageStatistics()
	tdSetupEnemyMechanics()
	tdSetupBuildDialog()
	tdSetupPadSelection()
	tdSetupDialogTrigger()
	tdSetupInventoryRuntime()
	tdSetupGroundItemRuntime()
	tdSetupLaneRects()
	tdStartLaneWaypointWatcher()
	tdStartEnemyDeathWatcher()
	tdStartLeakWatcher()
	tdSetupChatCommands()
	tdSetupHud()
	tdRefreshHud()
	for playerId = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
		if tdIsLaneActive(playerId)

	return false

public function tdCameraTargetDistanceForWheelLift(int extraSteps) returns real
	var clampedSteps = extraSteps
	if clampedSteps < 0
		clampedSteps = 0
	if clampedSteps > tdCameraWheelLiftStepCount()
		clampedSteps = tdCameraWheelLiftStepCount()
	return tdDefaultCameraTargetDistance() + clampedSteps * tdCameraWheelLiftDistancePerStep()

public function tdCameraTargetDistanceMin() returns real
	return tdCameraTargetDistanceForWheelLift(0)

public function tdCameraTargetDistanceMax() returns real
	return tdCameraTargetDistanceForWheelLift(tdCameraWheelLiftStepCount())

public function tdClampCameraTargetDistance(real distance) returns real
	if distance < tdCameraTargetDistanceMin()
		return tdCameraTargetDistanceMin()
	if distance > tdCameraTargetDistanceMax()
		return tdCameraTargetDistanceMax()
	return distance

public function tdStartupGuideMessage() returns string
	return "守住起点到终点的路线，在高台建塔。B 建造 / U 范围升级 / C 背包合成 / G 工资；Q 捕获 / W 收藏 / E 上阵。发起建造后建筑自行施工。滚轮调整镜头；精灵与装备都可强化塔。|n每漏过1名敌人扣除生命：普通1、精英和近卫队长2、首领3。首领关每路1名，入场后90秒限时。"

	if playerId == 0

		return lane2Active

	var inactiveCount = 0

				message += "、"

		return ""

	return "-addMoney "

	let prefix = tdAddMoneyCommandPrefix()

		return 0

		return 0

		FogMaskEnableOff()

	return 0

// Keep source references for the match: lingering native damage retains its tower.
class TDDamageTowerBinding
	unit source
	TDDamageRecord record
	construct(unit source, TDDamageRecord record)
		this.source = source
		this.record = record

Table tdDamageTowers = new Table()
LinkedList<TDDamageTowerBinding> tdDamageBindings = new LinkedList<TDDamageTowerBinding>()
boolean tdDamageReady = false
constant int TD_DAMAGE_TAG_LIMIT = 80
int tdDamageLiveTags = 0

public function tdDamageTrackTower(unit tower) returns TDDamageRecord
	if tower == null
		return null
	let key = tower.getHandleId()
	if tdDamageTowers.hasInt(key)
		let existingBinding = tdDamageTowers.loadInt(key) castTo TDDamageTowerBinding
		if existingBinding.source == tower
			if GetUnitTypeId(tower) != 0
				existingBinding.record.label = GetUnitName(tower)
			return existingBinding.record
	let lane = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(tower))
	if not tdIsLanePlayer(lane) or tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(tower)) == 0
		return null
	let record = tdDamageLedger.register(lane, GetUnitName(tower))
	let binding = new TDDamageTowerBinding(tower, record)

	return record

	// Cancellation/rejection must not register a tower that never completed.
	if tower == null or not tdDamageTowers.hasInt(tower.getHandleId())
		return
	let binding = tdDamageTowers.loadInt(tower.getHandleId()) castTo TDDamageTowerBinding
	if binding.source == tower
		binding.record.retired = true

public function tdDamageRefreshCatalog()
	for binding in tdDamageBindings
		if not binding.record.retired and binding.source != null and GetUnitTypeId(binding.source) != 0
			binding.record.label = GetUnitName(binding.source)
	tdDamageLedger.refreshOrder()
public function tdResetDamageStatistics()
	tdDamageTowers.flush()
	for binding in tdDamageBindings
		binding.source = null
		destroy binding
	tdDamageBindings.clear()
	tdDamageLedger.reset()
	// Existing tags still own their expiry decrement, even across a reset.

	if tdDamageLiveTags >= TD_DAMAGE_TAG_LIMIT
		return
	let tag = CreateTextTag()
	if tag == null
		return
	tdDamageLiveTags += 1
	SetTextTagText(tag, tdDamageText(amount), 0.020)
	SetTextTagPos(tag, GetUnitX(target), GetUnitY(target), 55.0)
	SetTextTagColor(tag, 255, 210, 80, 255)
	SetTextTagVelocity(tag, 0.0, 0.035)
	SetTextTagPermanent(tag, false)
	SetTextTagLifespan(tag, 0.9)
	SetTextTagFadepoint(tag, 0.55)
	// Allocate all handles synchronously; visibility alone follows the local view.
	SetTextTagVisibility(tag, IsUnitVisible(target, GetLocalPlayer()) and not IsUnitHidden(target))
	doAfter(0.95) ->
		tdDamageLiveTags -= 1

function tdDamageCaptureHit()
	if tdIsGameOver()
		return
	let source = DamageEvent.getSource()
	let target = DamageEvent.getTarget()
	if source == null or target == null or GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(target)) != TD_ENEMY_PLAYER_ID
		return
	let amount = tdEffectiveDamage(DamageEvent.getAmount(), target.getLife())
	if amount <= 0.0 or not tdIsLanePlayer(tdEnemyLaneId(target)) or tdEnemyWave(target) <= 0 or tdEnemyWasLeaked(target)
		return

	let record = tdDamageTrackTower(source)
	if record == null or not tdIsLaneActive(record.getLane())

	tdDamageShowHit(target, amount)

	if tdDamageReady or compiletime
		return
	tdDamageReady = true
	// Locked pre1.29 engine: event value is authoritative here, not pre-armor.
	// Reserve priority 4 after all early modifiers; never modify damage here.
	DamageEvent.addUnreducedListener(4) ->
		tdDamageCaptureHit()

function tdItemDefinitionIndex(int itemId) returns int
	// Rawcodes collide in Jass arrays, so item metadata must be resolved through the catalog.
	for index = 1 to tdItemDefinitionTotal
		if tdItemCatalog[index] == itemId
			return index
	return 0

	return quality + 1

public function tdItemIdForQualityRoll(int quality, int roll) returns int
	tdEnsureItemCatalog()
	let size = tdItemQualityCount(quality)
	if size <= 0
		return 0
	var clampedRoll = roll
	if clampedRoll < 1
		clampedRoll = 1
	if clampedRoll > size
		clampedRoll = size
	return tdItemQualityPools[tdItemQualityPoolKey(quality, clampedRoll)]

function tdItemEffectText(int effectKind, real value) returns string
	if effectKind == TD_ITEM_EFFECT_ATTACK
		return "攻击 +" + R2I(value + 0.5).toString()
	if effectKind == TD_ITEM_EFFECT_RANGE
		return "射程 +" + R2I(value + 0.5).toString() + "（装备射程加成上限500）"
	if effectKind == TD_ITEM_EFFECT_ATTACK_SPEED
		return "攻速 +" + R2I(value * 100.0 + 0.5).toString() + "%"
	if effectKind == TD_ITEM_EFFECT_COOLDOWN
		return "嗜血、剑刃风暴冷却时间缩短" + R2I(value * 100.0 + 0.5).toString() + "%（与精灵灵感合计上限40%）"
	if effectKind == TD_ITEM_EFFECT_KILL_GOLD
		return "本路非首领击杀金币 +" + R2I(value + 0.5).toString() + "\n每路每波额外金币上限：本波非Boss基础击杀金币总额。"
	if effectKind == TD_ITEM_EFFECT_ARMOR_SHRED
		return "普攻使目标护甲降低" + R2I(value + 0.5).toString() + "，持续3秒。\n同塔装备减甲相加后四舍五入，最高30；不同塔取最强效果。"
	if effectKind == TD_ITEM_EFFECT_EXECUTE
		return "普攻命中生命值不高于50%的主目标时，追加本次普攻伤害的" + R2I(value * 100.0 + 0.5).toString() + "%\n与首领追加比例相加；法术、分裂箭和精灵伤害不生效。普攻击杀时不再追加。"
	if effectKind == TD_ITEM_EFFECT_POISON
		return "普攻使目标中毒，每秒" + R2I(value + 0.5).toString() + "伤害，持续3秒。\n同塔装备毒伤相加，不同塔取最强效果。"
	if effectKind == TD_ITEM_EFFECT_CONTROL_POWER
		return "毒镖、缓速藤蔓的移动减速与盾击眩晕时间提高" + R2I(value * 100.0 + 0.5).toString() + "%（装备控制强化上限60%）"
	if effectKind == TD_ITEM_EFFECT_DROP_BONUS
		return "本路非首领装备掉落品质额外抽取" + R2I(value + 0.5).toString() + "次，取最好结果。\n不增加掉落件数，不改变首领奖励。"
	if effectKind == TD_ITEM_EFFECT_BOSS_DAMAGE
		return "普攻命中首领主目标时，追加本次普攻伤害的" + R2I(value * 100.0 + 0.5).toString() + "%\n与半血追加比例相加；法术、分裂箭和精灵伤害不生效。普攻击杀时不再追加。"
	return ""

public function tdItemTooltip(int itemId) returns string
	tdEnsureItemCatalog()
	let primary = tdItemEffectText(tdItemPrimaryEffectKind(itemId), tdItemPrimaryEffectValue(itemId))
	let secondary = tdItemEffectText(tdItemSecondaryEffectKind(itemId), tdItemSecondaryEffectValue(itemId))
	var tooltip = tdItemQualityName(tdItemQuality(itemId)) + "装备"
	if primary != ""
		tooltip += "\n" + primary
	if secondary != ""
		tooltip += "\n" + secondary
	tooltip += "\n塔可装备；同塔第3件同名装备仅发挥50%属性。\n放入工人前3格可参与同品质合成。"
	return tooltip

	var clampedRoll = roll

import GameTimer
import Table
import ClosureTimers
import TDEquipmentCombat
import TDEnemyMechanicRuntime
import TDBossRewardRules
import TDWaveFlowState

public unit array tdPetFarmers
real array tdPetCaptureReadyAt
constant Table tdPetBallOwners = new Table()
trigger tdPetBallPickupTrigger = CreateTrigger()
boolean tdPetRuntimeReady = false

public function tdPetNotice(int lane, string message)
	DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(Player(lane), 0, 0, 3.0, message)

public function tdPetSyncBallAbility(int lane)
	let farmer = tdPetFarmers[lane]
	if farmer != null
		farmer.setAbilityLevel(TD_PET_CAPTURE_ABILITY_ID, IMinBJ(tdPetBallsForLane(lane), 60) + 1)

public function tdPetEnemyIsValid(unit enemy, int lane) returns boolean
	return enemy != null and enemy.isAlive() and GetOwningPlayer(enemy) == Player(TD_ENEMY_PLAYER_ID) and tdEnemyLaneId(enemy) == lane and not tdEnemyWasLeaked(enemy)

public function tdPetLaneCanAct(int lane) returns boolean
	return tdPetLaneCanManage(lane)

public function tdPetCanDeploy(TDPet pet, unit tower) returns boolean
	if pet == null or pet.released or tower == null or not tower.isAlive() or not tdPetLaneCanAct(pet.lane)
		return false
	if GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(tower)) != pet.lane or tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(tower)) == 0 or tdPetBusyTowers.hasBoolean(tower.getHandleId())
		return false
	if tdPetForHost(tower) != null
		return false
	return true

public function tdPetDeploy(TDPet pet, unit tower) returns boolean
	if not tdPetCanDeploy(pet, tower)
		return false
	pet.recall()
	pet.host = tower
	pet.visual = createUnit(Player(pet.lane), tdPetVisualUnitId(pet.species), tower.getPos() + vec2(100.0, 50.0), 0 .fromDeg())
	pet.visual.setPathing(false)
	return true

function tdPetHandleCapture() returns boolean
	let farmer = GetTriggerUnit()
	if farmer == null or GetUnitTypeId(farmer) != TD_FARMER_UNIT_ID
		return false
	let lane = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(farmer))
	let target = GetSpellTargetUnit()
	let wild = tdPetWildFor(target)
	if not tdPetLaneCanAct(lane) or not tdPetWildCanCapture(wild, lane)
		tdPetNotice(lane, "只能捕获本路存活的野生宝宝。")
		return false
	let species = tdPetSpeciesForWildType(GetUnitTypeId(target))
	if species == 0
		tdPetNotice(lane, "这个目标不是野生宝宝。")
		return false
	if tdPetCollectionCount(lane) >= TD_PET_COLLECTION_LIMIT
		tdPetNotice(lane, "收藏已满20只。按W打开收藏，选择精灵后C养成、X释放；上阵精灵须先解绑。")
		return false
	let now = getElapsedGameTime()
	if now < tdPetCaptureReadyAt[lane]
		tdPetNotice(lane, "捕获冷却中。")
		return false
	if not tdPetSpendCaptureBall(lane, tdPetWildCanCapture(wild, lane))
		tdPetNotice(lane, "捕获球不足。")
		return false
	tdPetCaptureReadyAt[lane] = now + 1.0
	tdPetSyncBallAbility(lane)
	farmer.flashEffect("Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\Charm\\CharmCaster.mdl", "origin")
	target.flashEffect("Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\Charm\\CharmTarget.mdl", "origin")
	let guaranteed = wild.tutorial and not tdPetTutorialUsed[lane]
	if wild.tutorial
		tdPetTutorialUsed[lane] = true
	if not guaranteed and GetRandomInt(1, 100) > 60
		tdPetNotice(lane, "|cffff8080捕获失败|r，宝宝继续行进；剩余球 " + tdPetBallsForLane(lane).toString())
		return false
	let pet = new TDPet(lane, species, tdGetGlobalWave())
	pet.rollCaptureSkills()
	if not tdPetStore(lane, pet)
		// No yielding between capacity check and insertion; retain an explicit failure path.
		destroy pet
		tdPetAddBall(lane)
		tdPetSyncBallAbility(lane)
		tdPetNotice(lane, "收藏登记失败，已退还捕获球。")
		return false
	// RemoveUnit intentionally bypasses kill gold, score and all death drops.
	tdPetWildTransition(wild, TD_PET_WILD_CAPTURED)
	tdForgetEquipmentEnemy(target)
	tdEnemyMechanicUnregister(target)
	target.remove()
	wild.creature = null
	tdPetNotice(lane, "|cff80ff80捕获成功|r：" + pet.summary() + "。按W打开收藏，选择编号后E点塔绑定、C养成。")
	return false

public function tdPetHandleEnemyBallDrop(unit enemy, int lane, int wave)
	if tdPetIsWild(enemy) or enemy == null or GetKillingUnit() == null or not tdPetLaneCanAct(lane) or tdIsBossUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(enemy)) or tdEnemyWasLeaked(enemy)
		return
	if wave > 25 or GetRandomInt(1, 100) > 2 or not tdPetTakeDropBudget(lane, wave)
		return
	let ball = createItem(TD_PET_BALL_ITEM_ID, enemy.getPos())
	tdPetBallOwners.saveInt(ball.getHandleId(), lane + 1)

public function tdPetHandleBossBallCompensation(unit enemy, int lane, int wave)
	if enemy == null or GetKillingUnit() == null or not tdPetLaneCanAct(lane) or tdEnemyWasLeaked(enemy) or tdFlowBossResult(lane, wave) != TD_BOSS_RESULT_KILLED or not tdFlowClaimBossBallCompensation(lane, wave)
		return
	for _attempt = 1 to tdBossBallDropAttempts(wave)
		if tdBossBallDropSucceeds(GetRandomInt(1, 100)) and tdPetTakeDropBudget(lane, wave)
			let ball = createItem(TD_PET_BALL_ITEM_ID, enemy.getPos())
			tdPetBallOwners.saveInt(ball.getHandleId(), lane + 1)
			return

function tdPetHandleBallPickup()
	let ball = GetManipulatedItem()
	let carrier = GetManipulatingUnit()
	if ball == null or carrier == null or GetItemTypeId(ball) != TD_PET_BALL_ITEM_ID
		return
	let lane = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(carrier))
	let key = ball.getHandleId()
	let owner = tdPetBallOwners.loadInt(key) - 1
	if owner != lane or not tdPetLaneCanAct(lane) or not tdPetAddBall(lane)
		let position = carrier.getPos()
		UnitRemoveItem(carrier, ball)
		SetItemPosition(ball, position.x, position.y)
		tdPetNotice(lane, owner != lane ? "捕获球属于其他路线。" : "捕获球已满或路线已停止，道具留在地面。")
		return
	tdPetBallOwners.removeInt(key)
	UnitRemoveItem(carrier, ball)
	ball.remove()
	tdPetSyncBallAbility(lane)
	tdPetNotice(lane, "捕获球 +1 · " + tdPetBallsForLane(lane).toString() + "/60")

public function tdPetInitializeFarmer(int lane, unit farmer)
	tdPetInitializeLane(lane)
	tdPetWildPlanLane(lane)
	tdPetFarmers[lane] = farmer
	tdPetCaptureReadyAt[lane] = 0.0
	tdPetSyncBallAbility(lane)

public function tdPetSetupRuntime()
	if tdPetRuntimeReady
		return
	tdPetRuntimeReady = true
	tdPetSetupWild()
	registerSpellEffectEvent(TD_PET_CAPTURE_ABILITY_ID, function tdPetHandleCapture)
	tdPetBallPickupTrigger.registerAnyUnitEvent(EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_PICKUP_ITEM)
	tdPetBallPickupTrigger.addAction(function tdPetHandleBallPickup)
	doPeriodically(0.5) cb ->
		for lane = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
			for slot = 0 to TD_PET_COLLECTION_LIMIT - 1
				let pet = tdPetAt(lane, slot)
				if pet != null and pet.host != null
					if not pet.host.isAlive() or tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(pet.host)) == 0 or GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(pet.host)) != lane or not tdPetLaneCanAct(lane)
						pet.recall()
					else if pet.visual != null
						let desired = pet.host.getPos() + vec2(100.0, 50.0)
						if pet.visual.getPos().distanceTo(desired) > 1.0
							pet.visual.setPos(desired)
		if tdIsGameOver()
			for lane = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
				tdPetCancelRelease(lane)
			// All delayed attacks have zero delay or at most three one-second ticks.
			// Stop new procs now, then reclaim records only after every callback expires.
			doAfter(4.0) ->
				for pet in tdPetMatchRecords
					pet.recall()
					destroy pet
				destroy tdPetMatchRecords
				tdPetMatchRecords = null
				for lane = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
					for slot = 0 to TD_PET_COLLECTION_LIMIT - 1
						tdPets[lane * TD_PET_COLLECTION_LIMIT + slot] = null
			destroy cb

package TDPetState
import TDPetData
import TDPetRules
import TDConfig
import TDState
import TDEnemyMechanicData
import Table
import BitSet
import LinkedList

public class TDPet
	int lane
	int species
	int captureWave
	int level = 1
	int usedSkills = 0
	int skillCount = 0
	int array[4] skills
	int array[4] qualities
	int rotation = 0
	real readyAt = 0.0
	real buffUntil = 0.0
	int buffSkill = -1
	real buffPower = 0.0
	boolean pendingSkill = false
	unit host = null
	unit visual = null
	int generation = 0
	boolean paused = false
	boolean released = false
	int revision = 0
	int proposalSlot = -1
	int proposalSkill = -1
	int proposalQuality = 0
	int proposalVersion = 0
	int proposalRevision = 0
	int proposalOldSkill = -1
	int proposalOldQuality = 0

	construct(int lane, int species, int captureWave)
		this.lane = lane
		this.species = species
		this.captureWave = captureWave
		for slot = 0 to 3
			skills[slot] = -1

	function hasActiveExcept(int except) returns boolean
		for slot = 0 to skillCount - 1
			if slot != except and tdPetSkillIsActive(skills[slot])
				return true
		return false

	function rollSkill(int slot) returns int
		var mask = 0
		for index = 0 to skillCount - 1
			if index != slot
				mask = bitset(mask).set(skills[index]).val
		var count = 0
		for skill = 0 to 15
			if tdPetSkillAllowed(skill, slot, mask, hasActiveExcept(slot))
				count += 1
		if count <= 0
			return -1
		let rank = GetRandomInt(0, count - 1)
		var remaining = rank
		for skill = 0 to 15
			if tdPetSkillAllowed(skill, slot, mask, hasActiveExcept(slot))
				if remaining == 0
					return skill
				remaining -= 1
		return -1

	function setSkill(int slot, int skill, int quality)
		if slot < 0 or slot > 3 or slot > skillCount or skill < 0 or skill > 15 or quality < 1 or quality > 4
			return
		var mask = 0
		for index = 0 to skillCount - 1
			if index != slot
				mask = bitset(mask).set(skills[index]).val
		if not tdPetSkillAllowed(skill, slot, mask, hasActiveExcept(slot))
			return
		skills[slot] = skill
		qualities[slot] = quality
		skillCount = IMaxBJ(skillCount, slot + 1)
		usedSkills = 0
		for index = 0 to skillCount - 1
			usedSkills = bitset(usedSkills).set(skills[index]).val
		revision += 1

	function rollCaptureSkills()
		let count = tdPetSkillCountForRoll(GetRandomInt(1, 100))
		for slot = 0 to count - 1
			setSkill(slot, rollSkill(slot), tdPetQualityForRoll(GetRandomInt(1, 100)))

	function skillAt(int slot) returns int
		return slot >= 0 and slot < skillCount ? skills[slot] : -1

	function qualityAt(int slot) returns int
		return slot >= 0 and slot < skillCount ? qualities[slot] : 0

	function skillPower(int skill) returns real
		if paused or released or host == null
			return 0.0
		for slot = 0 to IMinBJ(skillCount, tdPetUnlockedSlots(level)) - 1
			if skills[slot] == skill
				return tdPetSkillPower(skill, qualities[slot])
		return 0.0

	function recall()
		generation += 1
		pendingSkill = false
		buffUntil = 0.0
		buffSkill = -1
		if host != null
			host.removeAbility(TD_PET_ATTACK_BONUS_ID)
			host.removeAbility(TD_PET_SPEED_BONUS_ID)
		host = null
		paused = false
		if visual != null
			visual.remove()
			visual = null

	function quality() returns int
		return tdPetOwnedQuality(skillCount, qualities[0], qualities[1], qualities[2], qualities[3])

	function summary() returns string
		return tdPetQualityName(quality()) + " " + tdPetSpeciesName(species) + " · " + skillCount.toString() + "技能 · 共鸣Lv" + level.toString() + (host == null ? " [收藏]" : " [上阵]")
public TDPet array tdPets
public LinkedList<TDPet> tdPetMatchRecords = new LinkedList<TDPet>()
int array tdPetBalls
boolean array tdPetWaveCredited
int array tdPetBallDrops
boolean array tdPetWildSpawnClaimed
public constant Table tdPetBusyTowers = new Table()

public function tdPetAt(int lane, int slot) returns TDPet
	if not tdIsLanePlayer(lane) or slot < 0 or slot >= TD_PET_COLLECTION_LIMIT
		return null
	return tdPets[lane * TD_PET_COLLECTION_LIMIT + slot]

public function tdPetCollectionCount(int lane) returns int
	var count = 0
	for slot = 0 to TD_PET_COLLECTION_LIMIT - 1
		if tdPetAt(lane, slot) != null
			count += 1
	return count

public function tdPetDeployedCount(int lane) returns int
	var count = 0
	for slot = 0 to TD_PET_COLLECTION_LIMIT - 1
		let pet = tdPetAt(lane, slot)
		if pet != null and pet.host != null
			count += 1
	return count

public function tdPetForHost(unit host) returns TDPet
	if host == null
		return null
	let lane = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(host))
	for slot = 0 to TD_PET_COLLECTION_LIMIT - 1
		let pet = tdPetAt(lane, slot)
		if pet != null and pet.host == host
			return pet
	return null

public function tdPetBallsForLane(int lane) returns int
	if not tdIsLanePlayer(lane)
		return 0
	return tdPetBalls[lane]

public function tdPetTakeBall(int lane) returns boolean
	if not tdIsLanePlayer(lane) or tdPetBalls[lane] <= 0
		return false
	tdPetBalls[lane] -= 1
	return true

public function tdPetAddBall(int lane) returns boolean
	if not tdIsLanePlayer(lane) or tdPetBalls[lane] >= TD_PET_BALL_LIMIT
		return false
	tdPetBalls[lane] += 1
	return true

public function tdPetStore(int lane, TDPet pet) returns boolean
	if not tdIsLanePlayer(lane) or pet == null or pet.lane != lane or pet.released or tdPetMatchRecords == null
		return false
	// A record has one match owner, even if its public lane was changed by a caller.
	// Validate against all owned records before touching slots or ownership lists.
	for owned in tdPetMatchRecords
		if owned == pet
			return false
	for slot = 0 to TD_PET_COLLECTION_LIMIT - 1
		let key = lane * TD_PET_COLLECTION_LIMIT + slot
		if tdPets[key] == null
			pet.level = tdPetResonance[lane]
			tdPets[key] = pet
			tdPetMatchRecords.add(pet)
			return true
	return false

// Internal no-reward removal for lifecycle/probe cleanup, never the player release entry.
// Keep discarded records alive until match end: delayed damage closures may hold them.
public function tdPetDiscardOwned(int lane, int slot) returns boolean
	let pet = tdPetAt(lane, slot)

		for slot = 0 to skillCount - 1
			if slot != except and tdPetSkillIsActive(skills[slot])
				return true
		return false

	function rollSkill(int slot) returns int
		var mask = 0
		for index = 0 to skillCount - 1
			if index != slot
				mask = bitset(mask).set(skills[index]).val
		var count = 0
		for skill = 0 to 15
			if tdPetSkillAllowed(skill, slot, mask, hasActiveExcept(slot))
				count += 1
		if count <= 0
			return -1
		let rank = GetRandomInt(0, count - 1)
		var remaining = rank
		for skill = 0 to 15
			if tdPetSkillAllowed(skill, slot, mask, hasActiveExcept(slot))
				if remaining == 0
					return skill
				remaining -= 1
		return -1

	function setSkill(int slot, int skill, int quality)
		if slot < 0 or slot > 3 or slot > skillCount or skill < 0 or skill > 15 or quality < 1 or quality > 4
			return
		var mask = 0
		for index = 0 to skillCount - 1
			if index != slot
				mask = bitset(mask).set(skills[index]).val
		if not tdPetSkillAllowed(skill, slot, mask, hasActiveExcept(slot))
			return

		skillCount = IMaxBJ(skillCount, slot + 1)
		usedSkills = 0
		for index = 0 to skillCount - 1

		revision += 1

		let count = tdPetSkillCountForRoll(GetRandomInt(1, 100))
		for slot = 0 to count - 1
			setSkill(slot, rollSkill(slot), tdPetQualityForRoll(GetRandomInt(1, 100)))

		return slot >= 0 and slot < skillCount ? skills[slot] : -1

		return slot >= 0 and slot < skillCount ? qualities[slot] : 0

		if paused or released or host == null
			return 0.0
		for slot = 0 to IMinBJ(skillCount, tdPetUnlockedSlots(level)) - 1
			if skills[slot] == skill
				return tdPetSkillPower(skill, qualities[slot])
		return 0.0

		generation += 1
		pendingSkill = false
		pendingSerial += 1
		buffUntil = 0.0
		buffSkill = -1
		if host != null
			host.removeAbility(TD_PET_ATTACK_BONUS_ID)
			host.removeAbility(TD_PET_SPEED_BONUS_ID)

		paused = false
		if visual != null

public function tdPetTakeDropBudget(int lane, int wave) returns boolean
	if not tdIsLanePlayer(lane) or wave < 1 or wave > 32
		return false
	let key = lane * 40 + wave
	var total = 0
	for originalWave = 1 to 25
		total += tdPetBallDrops[lane * 40 + originalWave]
	if total >= 1 or tdPetBallDrops[key] >= 1
		return false
	tdPetBallDrops[key] += 1
	return true

public function tdPetClaimWildSpawn(int lane, int wave) returns boolean
	if not tdIsLanePlayer(lane) or wave < 1 or wave > 32 or tdIsPureBossWave(wave)
		return false
	let key = lane * 40 + wave
	if tdPetWildSpawnClaimed[key]
		return false
	tdPetWildSpawnClaimed[key] = true
	return true

	if tower == null
		return
	tdPetBusyTowers.saveBoolean(tower.getHandleId(), true)
	let pet = tdPetForHost(tower)
	if pet != null
		pet.paused = true
		pet.generation += 1
		pet.pendingSkill = false

		return
	tdPetBusyTowers.removeBoolean(tower.getHandleId())
	let pet = tdPetForHost(tower)
	if pet != null
		pet.paused = false

		let pet = tdPetAt(lane, slot)

	tdPetCancelRelease(lane)
	tdPetPlayerLeft[lane] = false
	tdPetBalls[lane] = 3
	tdPetResonance[lane] = 1
	tdPetRerollStones[lane] = 0
	tdPetSlotStones[lane] = 0
	tdPetTutorialUsed[lane] = false
	for stage = 0 to 3

	for slot = 0 to TD_PET_COLLECTION_LIMIT - 1

	var best = 0.0
	for lane = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
		for slot = 0 to TD_PET_COLLECTION_LIMIT - 1
			let pet = tdPetAt(lane, slot)
			if pet != null and tdIsLaneActive(lane) and not tdIsLaneDefeated(lane) and not tdIsGameOver() and pet.host != null and pet.host.isAlive() and GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(pet.host)) == lane
				best = RMaxBJ(best, pet.skillPower(4))
	return best

		return false

function tdRejectTowerConstruction(unit tower, int playerId, int towerChoice, string message)

function tdValidateTowerConstruction(unit tower) returns boolean
	if tower == null
		return false
	let towerChoice = tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(tower))
	if towerChoice == 0
		return false
	let playerId = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(tower))
	if not tdIsLaneActive(playerId)
		tdRejectTowerConstruction(tower, playerId, towerChoice, "当前路线未启用，无法在这里建塔。")
		return false
	if tdCountLivingPlayerTowers(playerId) > tdGetTowerPopulationLimit()
		tdRejectTowerConstruction(tower, playerId, towerChoice, "已达到当前阶段人口上限，先升级已有防御塔。")
		return false
	let buildCenter = tower.getPos()
	if not tdIsInLaneBuildZone(playerId, buildCenter)
		tdRejectTowerConstruction(tower, playerId, towerChoice, "只能在自己象限的高台上建塔，中心出口禁止建造。")
		return false
	if not tdBuildPlotHasValidTerrain(buildCenter)
		// 静态 terrain mask 与地图禁建格同源，不会把新塔自己的占地误判成非法。
		tdRejectTowerConstruction(tower, playerId, towerChoice, "请在自己的高台上建造，并与悬崖保持 32 距离。")
		return false
	if not tdBuildPlotIsFlat(buildCenter)
		tdRejectTowerConstruction(tower, playerId, towerChoice, "整个建筑占地必须平整，请避开斜坡。")
		return false
	if tdTowerOverlapsAnotherTower(tower)
		tdRejectTowerConstruction(tower, playerId, towerChoice, "这里已被另一座塔占用，请勿重叠建造。")
		return false
	return true

// 虽然名字还是 createPads，但目前这里实际做的是给每个玩家生成建造农民。

	// Native cancellation owns the refund and removes the building after this
	// event. Reconcile food afterward; do not manually refund or clear another
	// tower's occupancy. Retain only playerId, not the soon-removed unit handle.
	let playerId = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(tower))
	tdClearTowerSaleState(tower)
	tdEvolutionForgetTower(tower)
	tdDamageRetireTower(tower)
	tdPetTowerRemoved(tower)
	tdForgetEquipmentTower(tower)
	tdForgetEquipmentAbilities(tower)
	tdDarkTideForgetTower(tower)

		tdAlignPlayerTowerPopulation(playerId)

function tdHandleTowerUpgradeCancelled()
	let tower = GetTriggerUnit()
	if tower == null or tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(tower)) == 0
		return
	let key = tower.getHandleId()
	let cancelledGeneration = tdGetTowerSaleState(tower).getWorkGeneration()
	// Cancellation restores native unit fields after the event, including range.
	doAfter(0.0) ->
		if tower == null or not tower.isAlive() or tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(tower)) == 0
			return
		if not tdTowerSaleStates.hasInt(key)
			return
		let state = tdTowerSaleStates.loadInt(key) castTo TDTowerSaleState
		if not state.finishWorkForGeneration(cancelledGeneration)
			return
		tdPetTowerWorkFinished(tower)
		tdEvolutionWorkFinished(tower)
		tdRefreshTowerEquipmentBonuses(tower)
		tdRefreshTowerRangeIndicatorsForTower(tower)
		tdEvolutionRefresh(tower)
		tdInitializeBloodlustAutocast(tower)

function tdHandleTowerUpgradeFinished()

		return

		return
	tdGetTowerSaleState(tower).finishWork()
	tdPetTowerWorkFinished(tower)
	tdEvolutionWorkFinished(tower)

	tdRefreshTowerEquipmentBonuses(tower)
	tdRefreshTowerRangeIndicatorsForTower(tower)

	tdDamageRetireTower(tower)
	tdPetTowerRemoved(tower)
	tdForgetEquipmentTower(tower)
	tdForgetEquipmentAbilities(tower)
	tdDarkTideForgetTower(tower)
	tdForgetBloodlustAutocast(tower)
	tdAlignPlayerTowerPopulation(GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(tower)))

function tdOrcBladestormStateKey(unit tower) returns int
	return tower.getHandleId()

function tdOrcBladestormIsActive(unit tower) returns boolean
	return tower != null and tdOrcBladestormStates.hasBoolean(tdOrcBladestormStateKey(tower))

function tdClearOrcBladestormState(unit tower)
	if not tdOrcBladestormIsActive(tower)
		return
	tdOrcBladestormStates.removeBoolean(tdOrcBladestormStateKey(tower))
	tower.removeAnimationProperties("spin")
	if tower.isAlive()
		tower.setAnimation("stand")

function tdPulseOrcBladestorm(unit tower)
	if tower == null or not tower.isAlive()
		return
	let center = tower.getPos()
	let ownerPlayerId = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(tower))
	let damagePerTick = tdOrcBladestormDamagePerSecond() * tdOrcBladestormTickInterval()
	let g = CreateGroup()
	g.enumUnitsInRange(center, tdOrcBladestormRadius())
	for victim in g
		if victim.isAlive() and GetOwningPlayer(victim) == Player(TD_ENEMY_PLAYER_ID) and tdEnemyLaneId(victim) == ownerPlayerId
			DamageEvent.setNextDamageFromCode()
			tower.damageTarget(victim, tdEnemyMechanicScaleSpellDamage(victim, damagePerTick))
	g.destr()

function tdHandleOrcBladestormCast() returns boolean
	let tower = GetTriggerUnit()
	if tower == null or tdOrcBladestormIsActive(tower)
		return false
	let key = tdOrcBladestormStateKey(tower)
	let pulseCount = (tdOrcBladestormDuration() / tdOrcBladestormTickInterval() + 0.5).toInt()
	tdOrcBladestormStates.saveBoolean(key, true)
	// The classic Blademaster embeds its blade trail in Attack Walk Stand Spin.
	tower.addAnimationProperties("spin")
	tower.setAnimation("stand spin")
	doPeriodicallyCounted(tdOrcBladestormTickInterval(), pulseCount) cb ->
		if not tdOrcBladestormIsActive(tower) or not tower.isAlive()
			tdClearOrcBladestormState(tower)
			destroy cb
		else
			tdPulseOrcBladestorm(tower)
			if cb.isLast()
				tdClearOrcBladestormState(tower)
				destroy cb
	return false

function tdHandleGhoulCorpseExplosionDamage()
	if DamageEvent.isSpell() or DamageEvent.isCode()
		return
	let source = DamageEvent.getSource()
	let target = DamageEvent.getTarget()
	if source == null or target == null or tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source)) != TD_TOWER_CHOICE_GHOUL
		return
	if source.getAbilityLevel(TD_GHOUL_CORPSE_EXPLOSION_DISPLAY_ABILITY_ID) <= 0
		return
	let maxLife = GetUnitState(target, UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE)
	if maxLife <= 0.405 or target.getLife() / maxLife > tdGhoulCorpseExplosionLifeThreshold()
		return
	if target.getLife() > DamageEvent.getAmount() + 0.405
		return
	let center = target.getPos()
	tdPetOnCorpseExplosion(source, center)
	let laneId = tdEnemyLaneId(target)
	let g = CreateGroup()
	g.enumUnitsInRange(center, tdGhoulCorpseExplosionRadius())
	for victim in g
		if victim != target and victim.isAlive() and GetOwningPlayer(victim) == Player(TD_ENEMY_PLAYER_ID) and tdEnemyLaneId(victim) == laneId
			DamageEvent.setNextDamageFromCode()
			source.damageTarget(victim, tdEnemyMechanicScaleSpellDamage(victim, tdGhoulCorpseExplosionDamageForBranch(tdTowerLevelForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source)), tdTowerBranchForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source)), tdTowerIsEvolved(source))))
	g.destr()
	let corpseExplosionEffect = AddSpecialEffect("Abilities\\Spells\\Undead\\DeathandDecay\\DeathandDecayDamage.mdl", center.x, center.y)
	DestroyEffect(corpseExplosionEffect)

function tdArcherSplitArrowFlightTime(unit source, unit target) returns real
	let projectileSpeed = tdTowerProjectileSpeed(TD_TOWER_CHOICE_ARCHER).toReal()
	if source == null or target == null or projectileSpeed <= 0.405
		return 0.0
	let distance = source.getPos().distanceTo(target.getPos())
	return distance / projectileSpeed

class TDArcherArrowVisual
	Fx fx
	vec3 startPos
	vec3 endPos
	real elapsed = 0.0
	real duration

	construct(unit source, unit target, real duration)
		this.startPos = source.getPos().withTerrainZ(90.0)
		this.endPos = target.getPos().withTerrainZ(60.0)
		this.duration = RMaxBJ(0.03, duration)
		fx = new Fx(startPos.toVec2(), source.getPos().angleTo(target.getPos()))
		fx.setXYZ(startPos, false)
		fx.setFx(tdTowerProjectileArt(TD_TOWER_CHOICE_ARCHER))

	ondestroy
		destroy fx

LinkedList<TDArcherArrowVisual> tdArcherArrowVisuals = new LinkedList<TDArcherArrowVisual>()
boolean tdArcherVisualTimerRunning = false

function tdLaunchArcherSplitArrowVisual(unit source, unit target, real duration)
	if source == null or target == null
		return
	tdArcherArrowVisuals.add(new TDArcherArrowVisual(source, target, duration))
	if tdArcherVisualTimerRunning
		return
	tdArcherVisualTimerRunning = true
	// One timer for all arrows, including volleys from several high-speed towers.
	doPeriodically(0.03) cb ->
		let itr = tdArcherArrowVisuals.iterator()
		while itr.hasNext()
			let arrow = itr.next()
			arrow.elapsed += 0.03
			let progress = RMinBJ(1.0, arrow.elapsed / arrow.duration)
			arrow.fx.setXYZ(arrow.startPos + (arrow.endPos - arrow.startPos) * progress, false)
			if progress >= 1.0
				itr.remove()
				destroy arrow
		itr.close()
		if tdArcherArrowVisuals.isEmpty()
			tdArcherVisualTimerRunning = false
			destroy cb

function tdFindFarthestArcherSplitArrowShot(LinkedList<TDArcherSplitArrowShot> shots) returns TDArcherSplitArrowShot
	TDArcherSplitArrowShot farthestShot = null
	var farthestFlightTime = -1.0
	for shot in shots
		if shot != null and shot.flightTime > farthestFlightTime
			farthestShot = shot
			farthestFlightTime = shot.flightTime
	return farthestShot

function tdTryAddArcherSplitArrowShot(LinkedList<TDArcherSplitArrowShot> shots, unit source, unit victim, int maxTargetCount)
	if shots == null or source == null or victim == null or maxTargetCount <= 0
		return
	let newShot = new TDArcherSplitArrowShot(victim, tdArcherSplitArrowFlightTime(source, victim))
	if shots.size() < maxTargetCount
		shots.add(newShot)
		return
	let farthestShot = tdFindFarthestArcherSplitArrowShot(shots)
	if farthestShot != null and newShot.flightTime < farthestShot.flightTime
		if shots.remove(farthestShot)
			destroy farthestShot
		shots.add(newShot)
		return
	destroy newShot

function tdArcherSplitArrowVolleyExpireDelay(TDArcherSplitArrowVolley volley) returns real
	if volley == null
		return 0.35
	var expireDelay = volley.primaryFlightTime + 0.35
	for shot in volley.extraShots
		if shot != null and shot.flightTime + 0.35 > expireDelay
			expireDelay = shot.flightTime + 0.35
	return expireDelay

function tdCreateArcherSplitArrowVolley(unit source, unit primaryTarget) returns TDArcherSplitArrowVolley
	if source == null or primaryTarget == null or tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source)) != TD_TOWER_CHOICE_ARCHER
		return null
	if source.getAbilityLevel(TD_ARCHER_SPLIT_ARROW_ABILITY_ID) <= 0
		return null
	let level = tdTowerLevelForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source))
	let remainingTargets = tdArcherSplitArrowTargetCount(level) - 1
	if remainingTargets <= 0
		return null
	let laneId = tdEnemyLaneId(primaryTarget)
	let sourcePos = source.getPos()
	let searchRange = tdTowerEffectiveRangeForTower(source)
	let primaryFlightTime = tdArcherSplitArrowFlightTime(source, primaryTarget)
	let g = CreateGroup()
	let extraShots = new LinkedList<TDArcherSplitArrowShot>()
	g.enumUnitsInRange(sourcePos, searchRange)
	for victim in g
		if victim != primaryTarget and victim.isAlive() and GetOwningPlayer(victim) == Player(TD_ENEMY_PLAYER_ID) and tdEnemyLaneId(victim) == laneId and sourcePos.distanceTo(victim.getPos()) <= searchRange + 0.405
			tdTryAddArcherSplitArrowShot(extraShots, source, victim, remainingTargets)
	g.destr()
	if extraShots.isEmpty()
		destroy extraShots
		return null
	for shot in extraShots
		if shot != null and shot.target != null
			tdLaunchArcherSplitArrowVisual(source, shot.target, shot.flightTime)
	return new TDArcherSplitArrowVolley(source, primaryTarget, primaryFlightTime, extraShots)

function tdExpireArcherSplitArrowVolley(TDArcherSplitArrowVolley volley)
	tdArcherSplitArrowVolleys.remove(volley)
	// Expiry is the only owner that destroys the volley; consumption only dequeues.
	destroy volley

function tdQueueArcherSplitArrowVolley(unit source, unit primaryTarget)
	let volley = tdCreateArcherSplitArrowVolley(source, primaryTarget)
	if volley == null
		return
	tdArcherSplitArrowVolleys.add(volley)
	let expireDelay = tdArcherSplitArrowVolleyExpireDelay(volley)
	doAfter(expireDelay) ->
		tdExpireArcherSplitArrowVolley(volley)

function tdConsumeArcherSplitArrowVolley(unit source, unit primaryTarget) returns TDArcherSplitArrowVolley
	let itr = tdArcherSplitArrowVolleys.iterator()
	while itr.hasNext()
		let volley = itr.next()
		if volley.source == source and volley.primaryTarget == primaryTarget
			itr.remove()
			itr.close()
			return volley
	itr.close()
	return null

public function tdSplitArrowLifetimeRegressionForTest() returns boolean
	let original = new TDArcherSplitArrowVolley(null, null, 0.0, new LinkedList<TDArcherSplitArrowShot>())
	tdArcherSplitArrowVolleys.add(original)
	let consumed = tdConsumeArcherSplitArrowVolley(null, null)
	let newer = new TDArcherSplitArrowVolley(null, null, 0.0, new LinkedList<TDArcherSplitArrowShot>())
	tdArcherSplitArrowVolleys.add(newer)
	let distinct = original != newer and consumed == original
	tdExpireArcherSplitArrowVolley(original)
	let preserved = tdConsumeArcherSplitArrowVolley(null, null) == newer
	tdExpireArcherSplitArrowVolley(newer)
	return distinct and preserved and tdArcherSplitArrowVolleys.isEmpty()

public function tdSplitArrowLiveVolleyCount() returns int
	return tdArcherLiveVolleyCount

public function tdSplitArrowPendingVolleyCount() returns int
	return tdArcherSplitArrowVolleys.size()

public function tdSplitArrowVisualCount() returns int
	return tdArcherArrowVisuals.size()

function tdHandleArcherSplitArrowAttack()
	let source = GetAttacker()
	let target = GetTriggerUnit()
	if source == null or target == null
		return
	if tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source)) != TD_TOWER_CHOICE_ARCHER
		return
	if source.getAbilityLevel(TD_ARCHER_SPLIT_ARROW_ABILITY_ID) <= 0
		return
	if not target.isAlive() or GetOwningPlayer(target) != Player(TD_ENEMY_PLAYER_ID)
		return
	tdQueueArcherSplitArrowVolley(source, target)

function tdArcherSplitArrowNativeAttackType() returns attacktype
	return ATTACK_TYPE_PIERCE

function tdDealArcherSplitArrowAttackDamage(unit source, unit target, real amount)
	if source == null or target == null or not target.isAlive() or amount <= 0.0
		return
	tdPetOnSplitArrowImpact(source, target)
	DamageEvent.setNextDamageId(TD_ARCHER_SPLIT_ARROW_DAMAGE_EVENT_ID)
	source.damageTarget(target, amount, true, true, tdArcherSplitArrowNativeAttackType(), DAMAGE_TYPE_NORMAL, WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)

function tdHandleArcherSplitArrowDamage()
	if DamageEvent.isSpell() or DamageEvent.isCode() or DamageEvent.getId() == TD_ARCHER_SPLIT_ARROW_DAMAGE_EVENT_ID
		return
	let source = DamageEvent.getSource()
	let target = DamageEvent.getTarget()
	if source == null or target == null or tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source)) != TD_TOWER_CHOICE_ARCHER
		return
	if source.getAbilityLevel(TD_ARCHER_SPLIT_ARROW_ABILITY_ID) <= 0
		return
	let volley = tdConsumeArcherSplitArrowVolley(source, target)
	if volley == null
		return
	let attackDamage = DamageEvent.getUnreducedAmount() * tdArcherSplitArrowDamageMultiplier(tdTowerLevelForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source)), tdTowerBranchForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source)), tdTowerIsEvolved(source))
	for shot in volley.extraShots
		if shot != null and shot.target != null and shot.target.isAlive()
			let victim = shot.target
			let impactDelay = shot.flightTime - volley.primaryFlightTime
			if impactDelay <= 0.03
				tdDealArcherSplitArrowAttackDamage(source, victim, attackDamage)
			else
				doAfter(impactDelay) ->
					tdDealArcherSplitArrowAttackDamage(source, victim, attackDamage)

function tdUnlockFarmerWageAbility()
	if tdFarmerWageUnlocked
		return
	tdFarmerWageUnlocked = true
	for playerId = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1
		if tdIsLaneActive(playerId)
			Player(playerId).setAbilityAvailable(TD_FARMER_WAGE_ABILITY_ID, true)

function tdStartFarmerWageUnlockWatcher()
	doPeriodically(0.25) cb ->
		if tdIsGameOver()
			destroy cb
		else if tdGetGlobalWave() >= tdFarmerWageUnlockWave()
			tdUnlockFarmerWageAbility()
			destroy cb

// 预留给建造/选择相关触发器注册的启动入口。
public function tdSetupDialogTrigger()
	if tdTowerGameplayEventsReady
		return
	tdTowerGameplayEventsReady = true
	tdSetupBloodlustAutocastOrders()
	registerSpellEffectEvent(TD_FARMER_WAGE_ABILITY_ID, function tdHandleFarmerWageCast)
	registerSpellEffectEvent(TD_ORC_BLADESTORM_ABILITY_ID, function tdHandleOrcBladestormCast)
	registerSpellEffectEvent(TD_TOWER_SELL_ABILITY_ID, function tdHandleTowerSellCast)
	tdTowerAttackTrigger.registerAnyUnitEvent(EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ATTACKED)
	tdTowerConstructionStartTrigger.registerAnyUnitEvent(EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_CONSTRUCT_START)
	tdTowerConstructionFinishTrigger.registerAnyUnitEvent(EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_CONSTRUCT_FINISH)
	tdTowerConstructionCancelTrigger.registerAnyUnitEvent(EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_CONSTRUCT_CANCEL)
	tdTowerUpgradeTrigger.registerAnyUnitEvent(EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_UPGRADE_FINISH)
	tdTowerUpgradeStartTrigger.registerAnyUnitEvent(EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_UPGRADE_START)
	tdTowerUpgradeCancelTrigger.registerAnyUnitEvent(EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_UPGRADE_CANCEL)
	tdTowerDeathTrigger.registerAnyUnitEvent(EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DEATH)
	tdTowerItemPickupVisualTrigger.registerAnyUnitEvent(EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_PICKUP_ITEM)
	tdTowerItemDropVisualTrigger.registerAnyUnitEvent(EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DROP_ITEM)
	tdTowerConstructionStartTrigger.addAction(function tdHandleTowerConstructionStarted)
	tdTowerConstructionFinishTrigger.addAction(function tdHandleTowerConstructionFinished)
	tdTowerConstructionCancelTrigger.addAction(function tdHandleTowerConstructionCancelled)
	tdTowerUpgradeTrigger.addAction(function tdHandleTowerUpgradeFinished)
	tdTowerUpgradeStartTrigger.addAction(function tdHandleTowerUpgradeStarted)

	DamageEvent.addListener(2) ->
		tdHandleGhoulCorpseExplosionDamage()

function tdHandleFarmerWageCast() returns boolean
	let farmer = GetTriggerUnit()
	if farmer == null or GetUnitTypeId(farmer) != TD_FARMER_UNIT_ID

	let playerId = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(farmer))

	tdRefreshHud()
	DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(Player(playerId), 0, 0, 4.0, "领取工资：+" + wage.toString() + " 金币。")

unit array tdFarmers
constant Table tdOrcBladestormStates = new Table()
constant Table tdTowerSaleStates = new Table()
constant int TD_ARCHER_SPLIT_ARROW_DAMAGE_EVENT_ID = 'Tspl'
int tdArcherLiveVolleyCount = 0
LinkedList<TDArcherSplitArrowVolley> tdArcherSplitArrowVolleys = new LinkedList<TDArcherSplitArrowVolley>()
image array tdTowerRangeIndicatorImages
unit array tdTowerRangeIndicatorTowers

boolean tdTowerGameplayEventsReady = false
boolean tdTowerSelectionEventsReady = false

trigger tdTowerConstructionFinishTrigger = CreateTrigger()
trigger tdTowerConstructionCancelTrigger = CreateTrigger()

trigger tdTowerUpgradeStartTrigger = CreateTrigger()
trigger tdTowerUpgradeCancelTrigger = CreateTrigger()

trigger tdTowerDeselectionTrigger = CreateTrigger()

trigger tdTowerItemDropVisualTrigger = CreateTrigger()
int tdTowerCountPlayerId = -1

function tdGetTowerSaleState(unit tower) returns TDTowerSaleState
	let key = tower.getHandleId()
	if not tdTowerSaleStates.hasInt(key)
		tdTowerSaleStates.saveInt(key, new TDTowerSaleState() castTo int)
	return tdTowerSaleStates.loadInt(key) castTo TDTowerSaleState

function tdClearTowerSaleState(unit tower)
	let key = tower.getHandleId()
	if tdTowerSaleStates.hasInt(key)
		let state = tdTowerSaleStates.loadInt(key) castTo TDTowerSaleState
		tdTowerSaleStates.removeInt(key)
		destroy state

function tdHandleTowerSellCast() returns boolean
	let tower = GetTriggerUnit()
	if tower == null or not tower.isAlive() or tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(tower)) == 0
		return false
	let playerId = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(tower))
	if not tdIsLaneActive(playerId)
		return false
	let state = tdGetTowerSaleState(tower)
	if not state.beginSale()
		return false
	let refund = tdTowerSellRefund(GetUnitTypeId(tower))
	let position = tower.getPos()
	for slot = 0 to 5
		let equipment = UnitItemInSlot(tower, slot)
		if equipment != null
			UnitRemoveItem(tower, equipment)
			SetItemPosition(equipment, position.x, position.y)
	tdClearTowerRangeIndicatorsForTower(tower)
	tdClearOrcBladestormState(tower)
	tdClearTowerSaleState(tower)
	tdEvolutionForgetTower(tower)
	tdDamageRetireTower(tower)
	tdPetTowerRemoved(tower)
	tdForgetEquipmentTower(tower)
	tdForgetEquipmentAbilities(tower)
	tdDarkTideForgetTower(tower)
	tdForgetBloodlustAutocast(tower)
	tower.remove()
	tdGainGold(playerId, refund)
	tdRefreshHud()
	doAfter(0.0) ->
		tdAlignPlayerTowerPopulation(playerId)
	return false

function tdHandleTowerUpgradeStarted()
	let tower = GetTriggerUnit()
	if tower != null and tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(tower)) != 0
		tdDarkTideForgetTower(tower)
		tdGetTowerSaleState(tower).startWork()
		tdEvolutionWorkStarted(tower)
		tdPetTowerWorkStarted(tower)

class TDArcherSplitArrowShot
	unit target
	real flightTime
	tdTrialCombatContext context
	int targetRevision

	construct(unit target, real flightTime)
		this.target = target
		this.flightTime = flightTime
		context = tdTrialCaptureContext(target)
		let binding = tdTrialBindingFor(target)
		targetRevision = binding == null ? 0 : binding.revision

class TDArcherSplitArrowVolley
	unit source
	unit primaryTarget
	real primaryFlightTime
	LinkedList<TDArcherSplitArrowShot> extraShots

	construct(unit source, unit primaryTarget, real primaryFlightTime, LinkedList<TDArcherSplitArrowShot> extraShots)
		this.source = source
		this.primaryTarget = primaryTarget
		this.primaryFlightTime = primaryFlightTime
		this.extraShots = extraShots
		tdArcherLiveVolleyCount += 1

	ondestroy
		tdArcherLiveVolleyCount -= 1
		if extraShots != null
			for shot in extraShots
				destroy shot
			destroy extraShots

function tdValidRangeIndicatorPlayerId(int playerId) returns boolean
	return playerId >= 0 and playerId < bj_MAX_PLAYER_SLOTS

function tdCreateTowerRangeIndicatorImage(unit tower) returns image
	let diameter = tdTowerEffectiveRangeForTower(tower) * 2.0
	let indicator = createImage(tdTowerRangeIndicatorTexturePath(), tower.getPos(), diameter, diameter, ImageLayer.L2)
	indicator.setColor(tdTowerRangeIndicatorColor())
	indicator.wrap()
	indicator.hide()
	return indicator

function tdClearTowerRangeIndicator(int playerId)
	if not tdValidRangeIndicatorPlayerId(playerId)
		return
	if tdTowerRangeIndicatorImages[playerId] != null
		tdTowerRangeIndicatorImages[playerId].remove()
		tdTowerRangeIndicatorImages[playerId] = null
	tdTowerRangeIndicatorTowers[playerId] = null

function tdClearTowerRangeIndicatorsForTower(unit tower)
	if tower == null
		return
	for playerId = 0 to bj_MAX_PLAYER_SLOTS - 1
		if tdTowerRangeIndicatorTowers[playerId] == tower
			tdClearTowerRangeIndicator(playerId)

function tdShowTowerRangeIndicatorForPlayer(player p, unit tower)
	let playerId = GetPlayerId(p)
	if tower == null or not tdValidRangeIndicatorPlayerId(playerId)
		return
	if not tdTowerRangeIndicatorEnabled()
		tdClearTowerRangeIndicator(playerId)
		return
	if tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(tower)) == 0
		tdClearTowerRangeIndicator(playerId)
		return
	tdClearTowerRangeIndicator(playerId)
	let indicator = tdCreateTowerRangeIndicatorImage(tower)
	tdTowerRangeIndicatorImages[playerId] = indicator
	tdTowerRangeIndicatorTowers[playerId] = tower
	indicator.showForPlayer(p)

function tdRefreshTowerRangeIndicatorsForTower(unit tower)
	if tower == null
		return
	for playerId = 0 to bj_MAX_PLAYER_SLOTS - 1
		if tdTowerRangeIndicatorTowers[playerId] == tower
			tdShowTowerRangeIndicatorForPlayer(Player(playerId), tower)

public function tdCanAffordTower(int playerId, int towerChoice) returns boolean
	return tdGetGold(playerId) >= tdTowerCost(towerChoice)

public function tdGetFarmer(int playerId) returns unit
	return tdFarmers[playerId]

// Native building pathing owns occupancy. Read live units rather than keeping a
// second reservation table: construction, upgrades, death and RemoveUnit cannot
// leave stale cells, and another owner's unfinished tower also blocks placement.
public function tdTowerBlocksPlacement(vec2 candidatePosition, vec2 otherPosition, boolean sameUnit, boolean alive, int otherTypeId) returns boolean
	return not sameUnit and alive and tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(otherTypeId) != 0 and tdTowerFootprintsOverlap(candidatePosition, otherPosition)

function tdTowerOverlapsAnotherTower(unit tower) returns boolean
	let nearby = CreateGroup()
	nearby.enumUnitsInRect(boundRect)
	var overlaps = false
	for other from nearby
		if tdTowerBlocksPlacement(tower.getPos(), other.getPos(), other == tower, other.isAlive(), GetUnitTypeId(other))
			overlaps = true
	nearby.destr()
	return overlaps

function tdCountPlayerTowerEnum()
	let tower = GetEnumUnit()
	if tower != null and tower.isAlive() and GetOwningPlayer(tower) == Player(tdTowerCountPlayerId) and tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(tower)) != 0
		tdTowerCountResult += 1

function tdCountLivingPlayerTowers(int playerId) returns int
	tdTowerCountPlayerId = playerId
	tdTowerCountResult = 0
	let g = CreateGroup()
	g.enumUnitsInRect(boundRect)
	ForGroup(g, function tdCountPlayerTowerEnum)
	g.destr()
	return tdTowerCountResult

function tdAlignPlayerTowerPopulation(int playerId)
	if compiletime or not tdIsLanePlayer(playerId)
		return
	SetPlayerState(Player(playerId), PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_FOOD_CAP, tdGetTowerPopulationLimit())
	SetPlayerState(Player(playerId), PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_FOOD_USED, tdCountLivingPlayerTowers(playerId))

function tdRejectTowerConstruction(unit tower, int playerId, int towerChoice, string message)
	// RemoveUnit does not use native cancellation/refund. A duplicate callback
	// sees typeId 0 and cannot credit the base build cost a second time.
	if tower == null or GetUnitTypeId(tower) == 0
		return
	tdClearTowerRangeIndicatorsForTower(tower)
	tdClearTowerSaleState(tower)
	tdEvolutionForgetTower(tower)
	tdDamageRetireTower(tower)
	tdPetTowerRemoved(tower)
	tdForgetEquipmentTower(tower)
	tdForgetEquipmentAbilities(tower)
	tdDarkTideForgetTower(tower)
	tdForgetBloodlustAutocast(tower)
	tower.remove()
	tdGainGold(playerId, tdTowerCost(towerChoice))
	// The engine still updates food after CONSTRUCT_START returns.
	doAfter(0.0) ->
		tdAlignPlayerTowerPopulation(playerId)
		tdRefreshHud()
	DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(Player(playerId), 0, 0, 4.0, message)

function tdValidateTowerConstruction(unit tower) returns boolean
	if tower == null
		return false
	let towerChoice = tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(tower))
	if towerChoice == 0
		return false
	let playerId = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(tower))
	if not tdIsLaneActive(playerId)
		tdRejectTowerConstruction(tower, playerId, towerChoice, "当前路线未启用，无法在这里建塔。")
		return false
	if tdCountLivingPlayerTowers(playerId) > tdGetTowerPopulationLimit()
		tdRejectTowerConstruction(tower, playerId, towerChoice, "已达到当前阶段人口上限，先升级已有防御塔。")
		return false
	let buildCenter = tower.getPos()
	if not tdIsInLaneBuildZone(playerId, buildCenter)
		tdRejectTowerConstruction(tower, playerId, towerChoice, "只能在自己象限的高台上建塔，中心出口禁止建造。")
		return false
	if not tdBuildPlotHasValidTerrain(buildCenter)
		// 静态 terrain mask 与地图禁建格同源，不会把新塔自己的占地误判成非法。
		tdRejectTowerConstruction(tower, playerId, towerChoice, "请在自己的高台上建造，并与悬崖保持 32 距离。")
		return false
	if not tdBuildPlotIsFlat(buildCenter)
		tdRejectTowerConstruction(tower, playerId, towerChoice, "整个建筑占地必须平整，请避开斜坡。")
		return false
	if tdTowerOverlapsAnotherTower(tower)
		tdRejectTowerConstruction(tower, playerId, towerChoice, "这里已被另一座塔占用，请勿重叠建造。")
		return false
	return true

function tdHandleTowerConstructionCancelled()
	let tower = GetCancelledStructure()

		return
	// Native cancellation owns the refund and removes the building after this
	// event. Reconcile food afterward; do not manually refund or clear another
	// tower's occupancy. Retain only playerId, not the soon-removed unit handle.
	let playerId = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(tower))
	tdClearTowerSaleState(tower)

	tdDamageRetireTower(tower)

function tdHandleTowerUpgradeCancelled()
	let tower = GetTriggerUnit()
	if tower == null or tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(tower)) == 0
		return
	let key = tower.getHandleId()
	let cancelledGeneration = tdGetTowerSaleState(tower).getWorkGeneration()
	// Cancellation restores native unit fields after the event, including range.
	doAfter(0.0) ->
		if tower == null or not tower.isAlive() or tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(tower)) == 0
			return
		if not tdTowerSaleStates.hasInt(key)
			return
		let state = tdTowerSaleStates.loadInt(key) castTo TDTowerSaleState
		if not state.finishWorkForGeneration(cancelledGeneration)
			return
		tdPetTowerWorkFinished(tower)
		tdEvolutionWorkFinished(tower)
		tdRefreshTowerEquipmentBonuses(tower)
		tdRefreshTowerRangeIndicatorsForTower(tower)
		tdEvolutionRefresh(tower)
		tdInitializeBloodlustAutocast(tower)

function tdOrcBladestormStateKey(unit tower) returns int
	return tower.getHandleId()

function tdOrcBladestormIsActive(unit tower) returns boolean
	return tower != null and tdOrcBladestormStates.hasBoolean(tdOrcBladestormStateKey(tower))

function tdClearOrcBladestormState(unit tower)
	if not tdOrcBladestormIsActive(tower)
		return
	tdOrcBladestormStates.removeBoolean(tdOrcBladestormStateKey(tower))
	tower.removeAnimationProperties("spin")
	if tower.isAlive()
		tower.setAnimation("stand")

function tdPulseOrcBladestorm(unit tower, tdTrialCombatContext context)
	if tower == null or not tower.isAlive()
		return
	let center = tower.getPos()
	let ownerPlayerId = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(tower))
	let damagePerTick = tdOrcBladestormDamagePerSecond() * tdOrcBladestormTickInterval()
	let g = CreateGroup()
	g.enumUnitsInRange(center, tdOrcBladestormRadius())
	for victim in g
		if tdTrialAoeTargetContextValid(victim, ownerPlayerId, context) and victim.isAlive() and GetOwningPlayer(victim) == Player(TD_ENEMY_PLAYER_ID) and tdEnemyLaneId(victim) == ownerPlayerId
			DamageEvent.setNextDamageFromCode()
			tower.damageTarget(victim, tdEnemyMechanicScaleSpellDamage(victim, damagePerTick))
	g.destr()

function tdHandleOrcBladestormCast() returns boolean
	let tower = GetTriggerUnit()
	if tower == null or tdOrcBladestormIsActive(tower)
		return false
	let key = tdOrcBladestormStateKey(tower)
	let pulseCount = (tdOrcBladestormDuration() / tdOrcBladestormTickInterval() + 0.5).toInt()
	tdOrcBladestormStates.saveBoolean(key, true)
	// The classic Blademaster embeds its blade trail in Attack Walk Stand Spin.
	tower.addAnimationProperties("spin")
	tower.setAnimation("stand spin")
	let context = tdTrialCurrentContext()
	doPeriodicallyCounted(tdOrcBladestormTickInterval(), pulseCount) cb ->
		if not tdTrialContextValid(context) or not tdOrcBladestormIsActive(tower) or not tower.isAlive()
			tdClearOrcBladestormState(tower)
			destroy cb
		else
			tdPulseOrcBladestorm(tower, context)
			if cb.isLast()
				tdClearOrcBladestormState(tower)
				destroy cb
	return false

function tdHandleGhoulCorpseExplosionDamage()
	if DamageEvent.isSpell() or DamageEvent.isCode()
		return
	let source = DamageEvent.getSource()
	let target = DamageEvent.getTarget()
	if source == null or target == null or tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source)) != TD_TOWER_CHOICE_GHOUL
		return
	// Trial abnormal death never becomes a corpse-explosion/drop farming source.
	if GetUnitTypeId(target) == 0 or tdTrialIsTargetType(target)
		return
	if source.getAbilityLevel(TD_GHOUL_CORPSE_EXPLOSION_DISPLAY_ABILITY_ID) <= 0
		return
	let maxLife = GetUnitState(target, UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE)
	if maxLife <= 0.405 or target.getLife() / maxLife > tdGhoulCorpseExplosionLifeThreshold()
		return
	if target.getLife() > DamageEvent.getAmount() + 0.405
		return
	let center = target.getPos()
	tdPetOnCorpseExplosion(source, center)
	let laneId = tdEnemyLaneId(target)
	let g = CreateGroup()
	g.enumUnitsInRange(center, tdGhoulCorpseExplosionRadius())
	for victim in g
		if victim != target and victim.isAlive() and GetOwningPlayer(victim) == Player(TD_ENEMY_PLAYER_ID) and tdEnemyLaneId(victim) == laneId
			DamageEvent.setNextDamageFromCode()
			source.damageTarget(victim, tdEnemyMechanicScaleSpellDamage(victim, tdGhoulCorpseExplosionDamageForBranch(tdTowerLevelForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source)), tdTowerBranchForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source)), tdTowerIsEvolved(source))))
	g.destr()
	let corpseExplosionEffect = AddSpecialEffect("Abilities\\Spells\\Undead\\DeathandDecay\\DeathandDecayDamage.mdl", center.x, center.y)
	DestroyEffect(corpseExplosionEffect)

function tdArcherSplitArrowFlightTime(unit source, unit target) returns real
	let projectileSpeed = tdTowerProjectileSpeed(TD_TOWER_CHOICE_ARCHER).toReal()
	if source == null or target == null or projectileSpeed <= 0.405
		return 0.0
	let distance = source.getPos().distanceTo(target.getPos())
	return distance / projectileSpeed

class TDArcherArrowVisual
	Fx fx
	vec3 startPos
	vec3 endPos
	real elapsed = 0.0
	real duration

	construct(unit source, unit target, real duration)
		this.startPos = source.getPos().withTerrainZ(90.0)
		this.endPos = target.getPos().withTerrainZ(60.0)
		this.duration = RMaxBJ(0.03, duration)
		fx = new Fx(startPos.toVec2(), source.getPos().angleTo(target.getPos()))
		fx.setXYZ(startPos, false)
		fx.setFx(tdTowerProjectileArt(TD_TOWER_CHOICE_ARCHER))

	ondestroy
		destroy fx

LinkedList<TDArcherArrowVisual> tdArcherArrowVisuals = new LinkedList<TDArcherArrowVisual>()
boolean tdArcherVisualTimerRunning = false

function tdLaunchArcherSplitArrowVisual(unit source, unit target, real duration)
	if source == null or target == null
		return
	tdArcherArrowVisuals.add(new TDArcherArrowVisual(source, target, duration))
	if tdArcherVisualTimerRunning
		return
	tdArcherVisualTimerRunning = true
	// One timer for all arrows, including volleys from several high-speed towers.
	doPeriodically(0.03) cb ->
		let itr = tdArcherArrowVisuals.iterator()
		while itr.hasNext()
			let arrow = itr.next()
			arrow.elapsed += 0.03
			let progress = RMinBJ(1.0, arrow.elapsed / arrow.duration)
			arrow.fx.setXYZ(arrow.startPos + (arrow.endPos - arrow.startPos) * progress, false)
			if progress >= 1.0
				itr.remove()
				destroy arrow
		itr.close()
		if tdArcherArrowVisuals.isEmpty()
			tdArcherVisualTimerRunning = false
			destroy cb

function tdFindFarthestArcherSplitArrowShot(LinkedList<TDArcherSplitArrowShot> shots) returns TDArcherSplitArrowShot
	TDArcherSplitArrowShot farthestShot = null
	var farthestFlightTime = -1.0
	for shot in shots
		if shot != null and shot.flightTime > farthestFlightTime
			farthestShot = shot
			farthestFlightTime = shot.flightTime
	return farthestShot

function tdTryAddArcherSplitArrowShot(LinkedList<TDArcherSplitArrowShot> shots, unit source, unit victim, int maxTargetCount)
	if shots == null or source == null or victim == null or maxTargetCount <= 0
		return
	let newShot = new TDArcherSplitArrowShot(victim, tdArcherSplitArrowFlightTime(source, victim))
	if shots.size() < maxTargetCount
		shots.add(newShot)
		return
	let farthestShot = tdFindFarthestArcherSplitArrowShot(shots)
	if farthestShot != null and newShot.flightTime < farthestShot.flightTime
		if shots.remove(farthestShot)
			destroy farthestShot
		shots.add(newShot)
		return
	destroy newShot

function tdArcherSplitArrowVolleyExpireDelay(TDArcherSplitArrowVolley volley) returns real
	if volley == null
		return 0.35
	var expireDelay = volley.primaryFlightTime + 0.35
	for shot in volley.extraShots
		if shot != null and shot.flightTime + 0.35 > expireDelay
			expireDelay = shot.flightTime + 0.35
	return expireDelay

function tdCreateArcherSplitArrowVolley(unit source, unit primaryTarget) returns TDArcherSplitArrowVolley
	if source == null or primaryTarget == null or tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source)) != TD_TOWER_CHOICE_ARCHER
		return null
	if source.getAbilityLevel(TD_ARCHER_SPLIT_ARROW_ABILITY_ID) <= 0
		return null
	let level = tdTowerLevelForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source))
	let remainingTargets = tdArcherSplitArrowTargetCount(level) - 1
	if remainingTargets <= 0
		return null
	let laneId = tdEnemyLaneId(primaryTarget)
	let sourcePos = source.getPos()
	let searchRange = tdTowerEffectiveRangeForTower(source)
	let primaryFlightTime = tdArcherSplitArrowFlightTime(source, primaryTarget)
	let g = CreateGroup()
	let extraShots = new LinkedList<TDArcherSplitArrowShot>()
	g.enumUnitsInRange(sourcePos, searchRange)
	for victim in g
		if victim != primaryTarget and victim.isAlive() and GetOwningPlayer(victim) == Player(TD_ENEMY_PLAYER_ID) and tdEnemyLaneId(victim) == laneId and sourcePos.distanceTo(victim.getPos()) <= searchRange + 0.405
			tdTryAddArcherSplitArrowShot(extraShots, source, victim, remainingTargets)
	g.destr()
	if extraShots.isEmpty()
		destroy extraShots
		return null
	for shot in extraShots
		if shot != null and shot.target != null
			tdLaunchArcherSplitArrowVisual(source, shot.target, shot.flightTime)
	return new TDArcherSplitArrowVolley(source, primaryTarget, primaryFlightTime, extraShots)

function tdExpireArcherSplitArrowVolley(TDArcherSplitArrowVolley volley)
	tdArcherSplitArrowVolleys.remove(volley)
	// Expiry is the only owner that destroys the volley; consumption only dequeues.
	destroy volley

function tdQueueArcherSplitArrowVolley(unit source, unit primaryTarget)
	let volley = tdCreateArcherSplitArrowVolley(source, primaryTarget)
	if volley == null
		return
	tdArcherSplitArrowVolleys.add(volley)
	let expireDelay = tdArcherSplitArrowVolleyExpireDelay(volley)
	doAfter(expireDelay) ->
		tdExpireArcherSplitArrowVolley(volley)

function tdConsumeArcherSplitArrowVolley(unit source, unit primaryTarget) returns TDArcherSplitArrowVolley
	let itr = tdArcherSplitArrowVolleys.iterator()
	while itr.hasNext()
		let volley = itr.next()
		if volley.source == source and volley.primaryTarget == primaryTarget
			itr.remove()
			itr.close()
			return volley
	itr.close()
	return null

public function tdSplitArrowLifetimeRegressionForTest() returns boolean
	let original = new TDArcherSplitArrowVolley(null, null, 0.0, new LinkedList<TDArcherSplitArrowShot>())
	tdArcherSplitArrowVolleys.add(original)
	let consumed = tdConsumeArcherSplitArrowVolley(null, null)
	let newer = new TDArcherSplitArrowVolley(null, null, 0.0, new LinkedList<TDArcherSplitArrowShot>())
	tdArcherSplitArrowVolleys.add(newer)
	let distinct = original != newer and consumed == original
	tdExpireArcherSplitArrowVolley(original)
	let preserved = tdConsumeArcherSplitArrowVolley(null, null) == newer
	tdExpireArcherSplitArrowVolley(newer)
	return distinct and preserved and tdArcherSplitArrowVolleys.isEmpty()

public function tdSplitArrowLiveVolleyCount() returns int
	return tdArcherLiveVolleyCount

public function tdSplitArrowPendingVolleyCount() returns int
	return tdArcherSplitArrowVolleys.size()

public function tdSplitArrowVisualCount() returns int
	return tdArcherArrowVisuals.size()

function tdHandleArcherSplitArrowAttack()
	let source = GetAttacker()
	let target = GetTriggerUnit()
	if source == null or target == null
		return
	if tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source)) != TD_TOWER_CHOICE_ARCHER
		return
	if source.getAbilityLevel(TD_ARCHER_SPLIT_ARROW_ABILITY_ID) <= 0
		return
	if not target.isAlive() or GetOwningPlayer(target) != Player(TD_ENEMY_PLAYER_ID)
		return
	tdQueueArcherSplitArrowVolley(source, target)

function tdArcherSplitArrowNativeAttackType() returns attacktype
	return ATTACK_TYPE_PIERCE

function tdDealArcherSplitArrowAttackDamage(unit source, unit target, real amount, tdTrialCombatContext context, int revision)
	if source == null or target == null or not target.isAlive() or amount <= 0.0
		return
	if not tdTrialTargetContextValid(target, GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(source)), context, revision)
		return
	tdPetOnSplitArrowImpact(source, target)
	DamageEvent.setNextDamageId(TD_ARCHER_SPLIT_ARROW_DAMAGE_EVENT_ID)
	source.damageTarget(target, amount, true, true, tdArcherSplitArrowNativeAttackType(), DAMAGE_TYPE_NORMAL, WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)

function tdHandleArcherSplitArrowDamage()
	if DamageEvent.isSpell() or DamageEvent.isCode() or DamageEvent.getId() == TD_ARCHER_SPLIT_ARROW_DAMAGE_EVENT_ID
		return
	let source = DamageEvent.getSource()
	let target = DamageEvent.getTarget()
	if source == null or target == null or tdTowerChoiceForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source)) != TD_TOWER_CHOICE_ARCHER
		return
	if source.getAbilityLevel(TD_ARCHER_SPLIT_ARROW_ABILITY_ID) <= 0
		return
	let volley = tdConsumeArcherSplitArrowVolley(source, target)
	if volley == null
		return
	let attackDamage = DamageEvent.getUnreducedAmount() * tdArcherSplitArrowDamageMultiplier(tdTowerLevelForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source)), tdTowerBranchForUnitTypeId(GetUnitTypeId(source)), tdTowerIsEvolved(source))
	for shot in volley.extraShots
		if shot != null and shot.target != null and shot.target.isAlive()
			let victim = shot.target
			let context = shot.context
			let revision = shot.targetRevision
			let impactDelay = shot.flightTime - volley.primaryFlightTime
			if impactDelay <= 0.03
				tdDealArcherSplitArrowAttackDamage(source, victim, attackDamage, context, revision)
			else
				doAfter(impactDelay) ->
					tdDealArcherSplitArrowAttackDamage(source, victim, attackDamage, context, revision)

function tdUnlockFarmerWageAbility()
	if tdFarmerWageUnlocked
		return
	tdFarmerWageUnlocked = true
	for playerId = 0 to TD_ACTIVE_PLAYER_COUNT - 1

function tdStartFarmerWageUnlockWatcher()

		if tdIsGameOver()
			destroy cb
		else if tdGetGlobalWave() >= tdFarmerWageUnlockWave()
			tdUnlockFarmerWageAbility()
			destroy cb

function tdHandleFarmerWageCast() returns boolean
	let farmer = GetTriggerUnit()
